review: Reviewed Sol's round-10 request (evidence-based preservation of roots or berries) and the accepted world-21 develop review (learning 3). The review requires a versioned per-resource moisture and spoilage model before any changed shelf life, and otherwise enables only the paired exposure-and-observation precursor in which both samples keep existing decay rules and no preserved status is awarded. Inspection found no defensible model for this world: food stacks carry only quantity, origin, harvest round and decay, and resources a static moisture property. The ex12 drying physics depends on a different food representation with per-sample water state and was not reused, because porting it would add new physics to this world. Implemented controlled-food-processing-trial@1 in scope long-ex14 as that precursor, a general operation for any learned actor and any owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food. Start places one or two whole units (default 2) at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions, in two paid work rounds of one energy each, with exact escrow portions that keep origin, age and decay; a single unit is recorded as having no matched control. The raised bark-and-branch support from the review is not required, because without a drying model it would have no physical effect and its stability and contact safety cannot be validated; this deviation is stated in the contract. Samples keep ageing under existing decay while unattended; the trial records rounds exposed and a predeclared 10-round observation checkpoint. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, in reach) records quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve (operator only, one round, one energy) returns only the remaining material. Cancel releases unfinished setup once; on an exposed trial it ends observation without moving food; death releases setup material on the ground. No nutrition change, safety certificate, extended lifetime or reward is added. Tests cover paid placement, distinct positions, conservation, identical decay of both samples, the checkpoint, unverified inspection records, operator-only retrieval and cancellation.
